verdict.rationale: Unleash documents segments as reusable collections of strategy constraints that can be shared across any number of flags. Activation strategies with context-field constraints enable features for specific users, and strategy variants serve different versions for A/B and multivariate testing. A community comment calling Unleash more limited is explicitly dated and hedged, so it does not concretely contradict the docs. Missing for 10: detailed evidence of constraint operators on user attributes (the only cited example is a currentTime date constraint) and independent hands-on corroboration of targeting depth.

support.subject: As a developer, I can target flags with attribute-based rules and reusable segments so the right users see the right variation

citations.quote: A segment is a reusable collection of strategy constraints... you can define a segment once and reuse it across any number of feature flags

They allow you to enable and disable features for certain users without having to redeploy your application.
